office_does: The Treasurer collects property taxes and other county revenue, pays county warrants and serves as treasurer for local taxing districts.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Treasurer Pam Johnson (Prefers Republican Party), in office since 2023, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Okanogan County Treasurer since 2023, in the Treasurer's office since 1995; the only candidate.
